items_flat.title_en: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5.2 (widely available) and Mythos 5.2 (restricted) as its most capable models for technical work in coding, finance, and sciences. Pricing is $8/$40 per million tokens (20% below 5.1), with faster output and a fast mode option.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出 Claude Fable 5.2（廣泛可用）與 Mythos 5.2（受限），作為編碼、金融與科學等技術工作的最強力模型。定價為每百萬 token $8/$40（較 5.1 低 20%），輸出更快，並有快速模式選項。
items_flat.analysis_en: The dual release (open vs. restricted safeguards) continues Anthropic’s pattern of tiered access for high-capability models. Early enterprise uptake and independent coding benchmarks will show if the price cut plus speed gain shifts share from Opus or GPT-6 lines.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 雙版本發布（開放 vs. 受限防護）延續 Anthropic 高能力模型分層存取模式。早期企業採用與獨立編碼基準將顯示降價加加速是否從 Opus 或 GPT-6 系列搶佔份額。
items_flat.quote: Our most capable models for daunting technical work, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 set a new bar in coding, finance, and the sciences.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們最強力的模型，針對艱鉅技術工作，Claude Fable 5.2 與 Claude Mythos 5.2 在編碼、金融與科學領域設立新標竿。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for secure agent purchases
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，支援代理安全購物
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Wallet, allowing dots (agents) to complete web purchases for US ChatGPT Pro users without accessing real card details. Each transaction requires biometric approval (e.g., Face ID), built with Amex, Mastercard, and Visa.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Wallet，讓 dots（代理）為美國 ChatGPT Pro 用戶完成網路購物，而不接觸真實卡號。每筆交易需生物辨識核准（如 Face ID），與 Amex、Mastercard、Visa 合作。
items_flat.analysis_en: This moves agents from recommendation to actual commerce with strong user controls. Early US Pro-only rollout and biometric friction will test adoption speed versus pure research agents.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這讓代理從建議邁向實際交易，並強化用戶控管。初期僅限美國 Pro 用戶且需生物辨識，將測試採用速度與純研究代理的差異。
items_flat.quote: We’re introducing ChatGPT Wallet, setting a new bar for secure payments by agents.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們推出 ChatGPT Wallet，為代理安全支付設立新標準。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind introduces Gemini 4 Hydrogen for everyday agentic work
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，聚焦日常代理工作
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Hydrogen as a fast, efficient model for coding and agentic workflows, priced at $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens flat across 1M context. It is rolling out to the Gemini API, AI Studio, Search, and paid Antigravity users.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，作為快速高效的編碼與代理工作模型，定價為每百萬 token $1.50/$7.50（全 1M 上下文固定）。正推向 Gemini API、AI Studio、Search 與付費 Antigravity 用戶。
items_flat.analysis_en: Hydrogen fills the high-volume/speed tier below Carbon and Argon, aiming to make Gemini 4 widely usable. Independent benchmarks will determine if the claimed speed and quality edge holds against Claude and GPT mid-tier models.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Hydrogen 填補 Carbon 與 Argon 之下的高量能/速度層級，目標讓 Gemini 4 廣泛可用。獨立基準將決定其速度與品質優勢是否對 Claude 與 GPT 中階模型成立。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing Gemini 4 Hydrogen, bringing cutting-edge intelligence to everyone — with speed and efficiency for everyday coding and agentic workflows.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Gemini 4 Hydrogen，將尖端智慧帶給所有人——以速度與效率處理日常編碼與代理工作流程。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches IPO roadshow targeting up to ~$1.4T valuation
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 啟動 IPO 路演，目標估值最高約 1.4 兆美元
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched the roadshow for its proposed Class A common stock IPO on Nasdaq under the symbol ANT. The offering prices shares at $70–$78, with expected trading around November 19 and additional private placement from cornerstone investors including Google and Nvidia.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 啟動擬議 Class A 普通股 IPO 路演，將在 Nasdaq 以 ANT 代號上市。發行股價區間 $70–$78，預期約 11 月 19 日交易，並有包括 Google 與 Nvidia 在內的基石投資人私募。
items_flat.analysis_en: The roadshow tests public-market appetite for frontier AI after the SpaceX listing. Valuation and demand will be closely watched as a sector benchmark, though final pricing and aftermarket performance remain uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 路演測試前沿 AI 在 SpaceX 上市後的公開市場胃口。估值與需求將被密切關注，作為產業基準，但最終定價與上市後表現仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today Anthropic, PBC launched the roadshow for its proposed initial public offering of its Class A common stock.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天 Anthropic, PBC 啟動其擬議 Class A 普通股首次公開發行的路演。

items_flat.title_en: Meta releases Muse Ember, its smallest efficient model for agent tasks
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Ember，最小且高效的代理任務模型
items_flat.summary_en: Meta Superintelligence Labs introduced Muse Ember, a low-cost model ($0.10/$0.50 per million tokens) designed for high-volume agent work such as tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, and long-document parsing. It is available on the Meta Model API and Muse Code.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta Superintelligence Labs 推出 Muse Ember，低成本模型（每百萬 token $0.10/$0.50），專為高量代理工作設計，如工具呼叫、編碼子任務、路由與長文件解析。已在 Meta Model API 與 Muse Code 提供。
items_flat.analysis_en: Ember targets the cheap worker role that pairs with larger frontier models. Cost leadership claims need independent verification against Haiku 5.5, Luna, and open models before it meaningfully changes multi-agent economics.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Ember 瞄準與較大前沿模型搭配的低成本工人角色。成本領先宣稱需獨立驗證對比 Haiku 5.5、Luna 與開放模型後，才會實質改變多代理經濟。
items_flat.quote: Today we're introducing Muse Ember, our smallest and most efficient model, built for complex reasoning execution and everyday agent work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們推出 Muse Ember，我們最小且最有效率的模型，專為複雜推理執行與日常代理工作而建。

brief_zh: 過去12小時無重大新宣布。近期背景仍為OpenAI ChatGPT Wallet、Google Gemini 4 Hydrogen、Anthropic Fable 5.2與IPO路演，以及Meta Muse Ember。
